title: SCA Minhag of the Week 283: "Wearing a Talet Qatan”

chapters.title: Sources from Rambam and Maran
chapters.about: Talit cotan, Rambam, Shulchan Aruch, Maran

chapters.title: Customs of Halab
chapters.about: Rabbis of Halab, blessings, sleeping with talit cotan

summary: Joey Harari explores the practice of wearing a talit cotan and the customs associated with it. He reviews sources including Mishne Torah, Shulchan Aruch, and the rabbis of Halab regarding blessings, wearing garments under clothing, and wrapping loops.
questions: What do Rambam and Maran say about wearing a talit cotan?
When should a blessing be recited on a talit cotan according to the customs of Halab?
Should a talit cotan be worn under or on top of clothing?
How many loops should be wrapped on the tzitzit of a talit gadol and a talit cotan?
